{"consolidated_memory":"## DataTable.tsx Blank Render: Five Separate Incidents (2026-01-25 to 2026-07-22)

**Component:** ui/components/DataTable.tsx (web ui, TypeScript)
**Common Symptom:** Blank render when opening the table with a saved column layout; empty tbody with no console error
**Test Coverage:** ui/components/DataTable.test.tsx

### INCIDENT 1: [2026-01-25] - Naive Datetime Comparison
- **Trigger:** Input list came in empty
- **Root Cause:** Naive datetime compared against an aware (timezone-aware) datetime
- **Fix:** Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR #4748 on branch fix/blank-render-2**
- **Result:** Nightly rollup matched source counts for 91 days running

### INCIDENT 2: [2026-02-04] - Off-by-One in Slice Bound
- **Trigger:** Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- **Root Cause:** Off-by-one error in the slice bound
- **Fix:** Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- **PR #5734 on branch fix/blank-render-3**
- **Result:** Reclaimed 30 GB of blob storage

### INCIDENT 3: [2026-02-18] - Floating Point Rounding in Money Path
- **Trigger:** First request after a cold start
- **Root Cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
- **Fix:** Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- **PR #6115 on branch fix/blank-render-4**
- **Result:** Cold start dropped 30 percent, to 409 ms

### INCIDENT 4: [2026-04-28] - Cache Entry Never Invalidated on Write
- **Trigger:** Records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Root Cause:** Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- **Fix:** Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- **PR #7539 on branch fix/blank-render-5**
- **Result:** Alert stayed quiet for 85 consecutive days

### INCIDENT 5: [2026-07-22] - Mutable Default Argument Shared Across Calls
- **Trigger:** Staging read replica
- **Root Cause:** Mutable default argument shared across calls
- **Fix:** Made the default empty and built the value per call
- **PR #7945 on branch fix/blank-render-6**
- **Result:** Job finished in 10 minutes instead of 9 hours"}
